serial_connection_failed.title: Vallox RS485 connection failed
serial_connection_failed.description:
Failed to connect to serial port `{serial_port}`. Please check:

1. The USB-RS485 adapter is connected
2. The adapter is properly wired to the Vallox unit
3. The serial port path is correct

The integration will automatically recover once the connection is restored.

communication_timeout.title: Vallox RS485 communication timeout
communication_timeout.description:
Communication with the Vallox unit on `{serial_port}` timed out. Please check:

1. The RS485 wiring is correct (A/B connections)
2. The Vallox unit is powered on
3. No other devices are causing bus conflicts

The integration will automatically recover once communication is restored.
